title: Simon's identity 4.11 for one cut-off: |T(g dη)| ≤ a·M_V(∂T) + c·μ_T(S) (parent step 9(b)–(d))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, U, V, S ⊆ ℝ^P, a, c ∈ ℝ, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep in U representing T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U). Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ with tsupport g ⊆ V, |g(x)| ≤ a and ‖Dg(x)‖ ≤ c for every x (operator norm of fderiv ℝ g x), and Dg(x) ≠ 0 only for x ∈ S. Let η ∈ 𝒟^m(U) satisfy |η(x)| ≤ 1 for every x, where |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm is the Euclidean coefficient norm. Then ofReal|R.action(g dη)| ≤ ofReal(a)·M_V(∂T) + ofReal(c)·μ_R(S). Here R.action(g dη) = ∫_M θ(x)⟨g(x)dη(x), ξ(x)⟩ dH^{m+1}(x) = T(g dη), dη = exteriorDerivative η, M_V = massOn V and μ_R = R.measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U V S : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U m) (a c : ℝ), R.Represents T → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → tsupport g ⊆ V → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ a) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ c) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → x ∈ S) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal |R.action (fun x => g x • exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a * T.boundary.massOn V + ENNReal.ofReal c * R.measure S
